title: Night Don Fall
tagline: The last danfo has dropped you. Your house is twenty minutes away, and the boys are somewhere ahead.

bonus.label: Keep your phone and money
bonus.lostMessage: You lost your money or your phone, so the bonus is gone.
bonus.earnedLine: You kept your phone and your money.

cash_low.label: No money left
cash_low.tip: You can't pay your way again.

dropped_name.label: You used a big name
dropped_name.tip: Lie gets easier, until somebody checks.

keke_ally.label: The keke man has your back

text.default: 10:40pm. The danfo conductor shouts "Last stop!" and everybody scatters. Street lights are off, again. Your house is twenty minutes away on foot, and you and {rival} are both walking home on your own roads. Mum is tracking your phone and has promised the rent transfer the second the dot stops at the house. Whoever gets home first tells it first. A last keke is idling at the junction. The main road is dark but empty. Past the bridge, the boys sit on the railings every night. Everybody knows.
text.coop: 10:40pm. The danfo conductor shouts "Last stop!" and everybody scatters. Street lights are off, again. Your house is twenty minutes away on foot, and you and {partner} are walking home together. A last keke is idling at the junction. The main road is dark but empty. Past the bridge, the boys sit on the railings every night. Everybody knows.
text.solo: 10:40pm. The danfo conductor shouts "Last stop!" and everybody scatters. Street lights are off, again. Your house is twenty minutes away on foot. A last keke is idling at the junction. The main road is dark but empty. Past the bridge, the boys sit on the railings every night. Everybody knows.

stakes.default: Your mum is watching your dot. Get home first, with the phone alive and the money still on you.
stakes.coop: Stay close and stay smart. Whatever goes wrong now follows you down the road.

choices.label: Sweet-talk the last keke rider into one more trip
Walk fast down the main road, head down, no stopping
Start a loud phone call: "Yes Daddy, I dey close, come out with the boys!"
Take the inner street where people are still outside

recap.default: {winner} sweet-talks the keke rider until he sighs, "Last one o. Enter." {loser} climbs in at the back, phone torch burning until the battery gives up.
recap.coop: You sweet-talk the keke rider until he sighs, "Last one o. Enter."

recap.default: {winner} walks the main road fast, head down, eyes ahead. The dark does not bother anybody who keeps moving. {loser} is a full lamppost behind, breathing loud.
recap.coop: You walk the main road fast, head down, eyes ahead. The dark does not bother anybody who keeps moving.

recap.default: {winner} shouts into the phone, "Yes Daddy, I dey close, come out with the boys!" Three guys by a pole stop talking. {loser} tries to look like somebody's son too, and doesn't.
recap.coop: You shout into the phone, "Yes Daddy, I dey close, come out with the boys!" Three guys by a pole stop talking.

recap.default: {winner} turns into the inner street where generators are humming and people are still outside. {loser} follows, a little late and a little lost.
recap.coop: You turn into the inner street where generators are humming and people are still outside.

recap.default: {winner} tries to sweet-talk the keke rider, but he lifts his head, says "I don tire for tonight," and drives off.
recap.coop: You try to sweet-talk the keke rider, but he lifts his head, says "I don tire for tonight," and drives off.

recap.default: {winner} starts down the main road too fast, steps on a loose gutter slab, and the phone flies out of their hand. The torch dies on the tarmac.
recap.coop: You start down the main road too fast, step on a loose gutter slab, and the phone flies out of your hand. The torch dies on the tarmac.

recap.default: {winner} shouts "Yes Daddy, come out with the boys!" into a phone that isn't connected, and a voice by the pole laughs, "Which Daddy?"
recap.coop: You shout "Yes Daddy, come out with the boys!" into a phone that isn't connected, and a voice by the pole laughs, "Which Daddy?"

recap.default: {winner} takes the inner street and walks straight into a burial canopy across the whole road: chairs, speakers, one very serious bouncer.
recap.coop: You take the inner street and walk straight into a burial canopy across the whole road: chairs, speakers, one very serious bouncer.

tie.recap: Nobody commits, and the keke rider drives off while you argue. A woman roasting corn calls you into the inner street.

keke_ride.title: Last Trip
keke_ride.text: The keke bounces through potholes on one headlight. The rider hums Fuji and does not say a word until the bridge shows up in the dark. He slows down. "This na where my road end," he says. "After this one, na boys territory. I no dey go." He isn't asking. Ahead, the bridge railings have little red dots on them: cigarettes.

stakes.default: He drops you here unless you give him a reason to go further. A shorter road gets Mum's dot home sooner.
stakes.coop: He drops you here unless you give him a reason to go further.

choices.label: Ask him to keep his headlight on you until you cross. "Make dem see say person dey watch me."
Pay ₦2,500 and ask him to carry you past the bridge

lock.reason: You don't have money left to pay with.

choices.label: Tell him your father is a DPO and he will hear about this
Agree to stop here, but ask which lane the boys don't use

recap.default: {winner} asks him to keep the headlight on them until the far side. He grumbles, then keeps it on. {loser} stands in the glare and is seen very clearly by everybody on the bridge.
recap.coop: You ask him to keep the headlight on you until the far side. He grumbles, then keeps it on.

recap.default: {winner} pays ₦2,500. He counts it twice, mutters, then guns the keke straight over the bridge and past the boys before they can stand up, and drops them at the vigilante post. {loser} watches the money go and the boys blur by.
recap.coop: You pay ₦2,500. He counts it twice, mutters, then guns the keke straight over the bridge and past the boys before they can stand up, and drops you at the vigilante post.

recap.default: {winner} says "My father is DPO." His face tightens. He takes the bridge without a word, drops them at the next corner and does not say goodnight. {loser} sits stiff and hopes nobody checks.
recap.coop: You say "My father is DPO." His face tightens. He takes the bridge without a word, drops you at the next corner and does not say goodnight.

recap.default: {winner} asks which lane the boys don't use. He points: "Behind the mechanic yard. Dark, but nobody dey there." {loser} hears it too, and cannot unhear how dark it is.
recap.coop: You ask which lane the boys don't use. He points: "Behind the mechanic yard. Dark, but nobody dey there."

recap.default: {winner} asks him to keep the light on. He yawns, kills the engine, and the headlight dies. On the bridge, four heads turn toward the sound.
recap.coop: You ask him to keep the light on. He yawns, kills the engine, and the headlight dies. On the bridge, four heads turn toward the sound.

recap.default: {winner} hands over ₦2,500. He takes it, stops at the bridge anyway, and says, "My own road end here." He drives off with the money.
recap.coop: You hand over ₦2,500. He takes it, stops at the bridge anyway, and says, "My own road end here." He drives off with the money.

recap.default: {winner} drops the DPO line. The rider laughs. "Every night, person be DPO pikin." He puts them down right there, loudly, in front of the boys.
recap.coop: You drop the DPO line. The rider laughs. "Every night, person be DPO pikin." He puts you down right there, loudly, in front of the boys.

recap.default: {winner} agrees to stop. He mumbles an answer, they miss half of it, and they walk into the wrong lane.
recap.coop: You agree to stop. He mumbles an answer, you miss half of it, and you walk into the wrong lane.

tie.recap: Nobody speaks. The rider shrugs and drops you at the foot of the bridge.

road_clear.title: Good Time
road_clear.text: You made good time. The street lamp is dead, but your eyes have adjusted, and the bridge is two hundred metres ahead. Four shapes on the railings. A cigarette glows. A small speaker plays Asake, low. Nobody has noticed you yet, which means you still get to decide how they meet you.

stakes.default: Thirty seconds before they look up. Keep your dot moving and your phone out of sight.
stakes.coop: You have about thirty seconds before they look up.

choices.label: Greet them like neighbours: "Boys! Una dey? Wetin dey?"
Pick up speed and cross before anybody can stand up
Hold your phone to your ear: "Yes, I'm at the bridge now, I see them"
Slow down, keep to the wall's shadow, and watch who is in charge

recap.default: {winner} greets them before they can greet them. One of them laughs and says, "This one get liver." {loser} hangs back and looks like a customer.
recap.coop: You greet them before they can greet you. One of them laughs and says, "This one get liver."

recap.default: {winner} picks up speed and is already at the far railing before the first one stands up. {loser} starts too late and meets them halfway.
recap.coop: You pick up speed and are already at the far railing before the first one stands up.

recap.default: {winner} holds the phone to their ear and says, "Yes, I see them, four of them." The boys hear. Two of them look at each other. {loser} copies the move and looks like an actor.
recap.coop: You hold the phone to your ear and say, "Yes, I see them, four of them." The boys hear. Two of them look at each other.

recap.default: {winner} stays in the shadow and watches. The one in the centre does the talking, the others laugh on cue. {loser} steps on a bottle and four heads turn.
recap.coop: You stay in the shadow and watch. The one in the centre does the talking, the others laugh on cue.

recap.default: {winner} says "Boys!" too loud and too early. They stop talking and look. Not friendly.
recap.coop: You say "Boys!" too loud and too early. They stop talking and look. Not friendly.

recap.default: {winner} runs. They hear the footsteps and spread across the road like a gate.
recap.coop: You run. They hear the footsteps and spread across the road like a gate.

recap.default: {winner} speaks into a dead phone. One of them says, "Who you dey call?" {loser} freezes with the phone still at their ear.
recap.coop: You speak into a dead phone. One of them says, "Who you dey call?"

recap.default: {winner} watches too long. The one in the centre spots the shadow moving and points.
recap.coop: You watch too long. The one in the centre spots the shadow moving and points.

tie.recap: You both hesitate. The music stops. Somebody says, "Who dey there?"

call_works.title: Called It
call_works.text: The boys heard you. They are not sure what they heard, but they are quieter now. You are past the pole and the bridge is thirty metres ahead. The one who was smoking has stood up. He is not blocking the road yet, but he is looking at your pocket.

stakes.default: Your lie is working and Mum's dot is still moving. It does not last.
stakes.coop: The phone call bought you seconds. Use them or lose them.

choices.label: Smile and say "Just dey pass, boys. No wahala."
Sprint the last thirty metres and don't look back
Speak into the phone again: "Yes, I see him. Black shirt. Come now."
Walk straight but slow, eyes forward, like you belong here

recap.default: {winner} smiles and says "Just dey pass." The smoker sits back down. {loser} nods too fast and looks like a student.
recap.coop: You smile and say "Just dey pass." The smoker sits back down.

recap.default: {winner} sprints. The boys shout but do not chase. {loser} starts too late and one of them grabs at their shirt.
recap.coop: You sprint. The boys shout but do not chase.

recap.default: {winner} describes the black shirt into the phone. The smoker looks at his own shirt and steps back. {loser} describes the wrong shirt and the wrong boy laughs.
recap.coop: You describe the black shirt into the phone. The smoker looks at his own shirt and steps back.

recap.default: {winner} walks like they live here. The boys watch but do not move. {loser} walks like they are being watched, which they are.
recap.coop: You walk like you live here. The boys watch but do not move.

recap.default: {winner} says "No wahala" with a shaking voice. The smoker says, "Wahala dey."
recap.coop: You say "No wahala" with a shaking voice. The smoker says, "Wahala dey."

recap.default: {winner} sprints. They chase. Three against one is not a race.
recap.coop: You sprint. They chase. Three against one is not a race.

recap.default: {winner} says "Come now" into a dead phone. The smoker says, "Make I help you dial?"
recap.coop: You say "Come now" into a dead phone. The smoker says, "Make I help you dial?"

recap.default: {winner} walks slow and straight. The smoker steps into the road and blocks the path.
recap.coop: You walk slow and straight. The smoker steps into the road and blocks the path.

tie.recap: You both freeze. The smoker says, "Una wan cross?" It is not a question.

corn_aunty.title: Inner Street
corn_aunty.text: The inner street is alive. A woman roasts corn over charcoal. Two men argue about football outside a shop. A generator hums behind a fence. You are not alone here, but you are not home yet. The path narrows past the corn smoke and turns left toward the bridge's underside.

stakes.default: The safest stretch of the road, and a shortcut if you play it right. Mum's dot is still moving.
stakes.coop: The corn aunty sees everybody. Stay visible and stay moving.

choices.label: Buy corn and ask the aunty if the bridge boys are out tonight
Walk past without stopping, eyes on the turning ahead
Tell the football men their team lost because of bad coaching
Wait and watch who else takes the turning toward the bridge

recap.default: {winner} buys corn and asks. The aunty says, "Dem dey there since six." {loser} buys corn and says nothing useful.
recap.coop: You buy corn and ask. The aunty says, "Dem dey there since six."

recap.default: {winner} walks past fast. The aunty shouts, "You no go buy?" {loser} looks back and trips on the gutter.
recap.coop: You walk past fast. The aunty shouts, "You no go buy?"

recap.default: {winner} insults the team. The men argue with them instead of watching the turning. {loser} agrees with the wrong side and gets shouted at.
recap.coop: You insult the team. The men argue with you instead of watching the turning.

recap.default: {winner} watches. Two boys take the turning with their hands in their pockets. Not customers. {loser} waits too long and the aunty asks if they are lost.
recap.coop: You watch. Two boys take the turning with their hands in their pockets. Not customers.

recap.default: {winner} asks about the boys. The aunty shouts, "Wetin you dey find for there?" Everybody looks.
recap.coop: You ask about the boys. The aunty shouts, "Wetin you dey find for there?" Everybody looks.

recap.default: {winner} walks fast into the turning and meets a locked gate. Dead end.
recap.coop: You walk fast into the turning and meet a locked gate. Dead end.

recap.default: {winner} argues football. One of the men says, "You sabi too much." It goes wrong.
recap.coop: You argue football. One of the men says, "You sabi too much." It goes wrong.

recap.default: {winner} watches too long. The aunty says, "You dey plan something?"
recap.coop: You watch too long. The aunty says, "You dey plan something?"

tie.recap: You both stand there. The aunty says, "Una go buy or una go waka?"

keke_gone.title: Walking Now
keke_gone.text: The keke's tail light disappears around the corner. You are on the main road with nothing but your feet and your phone battery. The bridge is ten minutes ahead. The railings are visible now, little red dots in the dark.

stakes.default: You've lost time, and Mum is watching a dot that has stopped moving. Every road home is darker now.
stakes.coop: No ride, no shortcut. The road is what you have.

choices.label: Walk confident, head up, like you are almost home
Cut through the uncompleted building site to the left
Call out: "Boys! I dey come o! Make una no dull!"
Cross to the other side and walk in the gutter shadow

recap.default: {winner} walks like they own the road. The boys watch but do not move. {loser} walks like they are late for something, which they are.
recap.coop: You walk like you own the road. The boys watch but do not move.

recap.default: {winner} cuts through the site and comes out behind the bridge, muddy but past the railings. {loser} steps on a nail and limps the rest of the way.
recap.coop: You cut through the site and come out behind the bridge, muddy but past the railings.

recap.default: {winner} shouts a greeting. The boys shout back, and not in a friendly way. {loser} shouts too late and sounds scared.
recap.coop: You shout a greeting. The boys shout back, and not in a friendly way.

recap.default: {winner} crosses and walks in the shadow. The boys are watching the main road, not the gutter. {loser} steps in water and curses loud.
recap.coop: You cross and walk in the shadow. The boys are watching the main road, not the gutter.

recap.default: {winner} walks confident but too slow. The boys have time to get interested.
recap.coop: You walk confident but too slow. The boys have time to get interested.

recap.default: {winner} climbs through the site fence and lands in a pit of rainwater and broken blocks.
recap.coop: You climb through the site fence and land in a pit of rainwater and broken blocks.

recap.default: {winner} shouts and one of them stands up. He is very tall.
recap.coop: You shout and one of them stands up. He is very tall.

recap.default: {winner} crosses but trips on the gutter and the phone falls. The screen lights up their face.
recap.coop: You cross but trip on the gutter and the phone falls. The screen lights up your face.

tie.recap: You both walk. The boys watch. Nobody says anything yet.

road_snag.title: No Light
road_snag.text: Your phone is dead. The torch is gone. The street lamp is still dead. You can see the bridge by memory, not by light. The shapes on the railings are darker than the dark around them.

stakes.default: No torch, and Mum's dot is about to go dark. Get across before somebody hears you.
stakes.coop: No phone, no torch. Stay together or lose each other.

choices.label: Walk toward the bridge singing a song they might know
Run blind and trust your feet know this road
Shout: "I be Ajala's cousin! Anybody wey touch me go hear am!"
Crawl along the gutter edge where the wall guides you

recap.default: {winner} sings "Buga" off-key. One of them laughs and says, "This one don craze." {loser} tries to sing too and sounds like a victim.
recap.coop: You sing "Buga" off-key. One of them laughs and says, "This one don craze."

recap.default: {winner} runs and does not fall. The boys hear footsteps but cannot see who. {loser} runs into a pole and the boys hear that too.
recap.coop: You run and do not fall. The boys hear footsteps but cannot see who.

recap.default: {winner} drops Ajala's name. One of them says, "Ajala no get cousin for here." {loser} drops the same name and sounds desperate.
recap.coop: You drop Ajala's name. One of them says, "Ajala no get cousin for here."

recap.default: {winner} crawls along the wall. The gutter stinks but the wall is true. {loser} crawls too slow and the boys hear the scraping.
recap.coop: You crawl along the wall. The gutter stinks but the wall is true.

recap.default: {winner} sings a gospel song. They do not laugh.
recap.coop: You sing a gospel song. They do not laugh.

recap.default: {winner} runs into a parked truck. The noise brings all four down from the railings.
recap.coop: You run into a parked truck. The noise brings all four down from the railings.

recap.default: {winner} shouts Ajala's name. Somebody says, "Who be Ajala?"
recap.coop: You shout Ajala's name. Somebody says, "Who be Ajala?"

recap.default: {winner} crawls into a drain. It is deeper than it looks.
recap.coop: You crawl into a drain. It is deeper than it looks.

tie.recap: You both stand in the dark. Somebody says, "Who dey there?" You cannot see who.

call_exposed.title: They Know
call_exposed.text: They know you were bluffing. One of them is walking toward you. He is not running. He does not need to. The others are still on the railings, watching. Your phone is in your hand. It is not helping.

stakes.default: The bluff is dead and your phone is in your hand. Own it before it costs you the phone.
stakes.coop: The bluff is dead. Decide together or decide alone.

choices.label: Laugh and say "Na joke o. I dey find my brother. You see am?"
Turn and walk back the way you came, fast but not running
Dial a real number and say "Hello? Yes, I need police at the bridge now."
Stand still and ask "How much make I pass?" like you have done this before

recap.default: {winner} laughs and asks for a brother. The walker says, "You no resemble anybody brother." But he stops walking. {loser} laughs too high and the walker keeps coming.
recap.coop: You laugh and ask for a brother. The walker says, "You no resemble anybody brother." But he stops walking.

recap.default: {winner} walks back fast. The walker does not follow. The railings watch them go. {loser} walks back slow and the walker follows three steps behind.
recap.coop: You walk back fast. The walker does not follow. The railings watch you go.

recap.default: {winner} dials and speaks loud. The walker stops. He cannot tell if it is real. {loser} dials and the phone rings in their own pocket.
recap.coop: You dial and speak loud. The walker stops. He cannot tell if it is real.

recap.default: {winner} asks the price. The walker says, "₦500." It is not a request. {loser} asks the price and the walker says, "₦2,000."
recap.coop: You ask the price. The walker says, "₦500." It is not a request.

recap.default: {winner} jokes and the walker slaps the phone out of their hand.
recap.coop: You joke and the walker slaps the phone out of your hand.

recap.default: {winner} walks back and the walker grabs their shirt.
recap.coop: You walk back and the walker grabs your shirt.

recap.default: {winner} dials and the call goes to voicemail. The walker hears the beep.
recap.coop: You dial and the call goes to voicemail. The walker hears the beep.

recap.default: {winner} asks the price. The walker says, "Your phone."
recap.coop: You ask the price. The walker says, "Your phone."

tie.recap: You both freeze. The walker says, "So?" Nobody has an answer.

street_blocked.title: Dead End
street_blocked.text: The burial canopy blocks the whole street. The bouncer looks at you like you are the next problem. Behind him, chairs are stacked and a speaker plays mourning music. The bridge is behind you now. The inner street is behind you too.

stakes.default: Nobody here can help you, and Mum's dot has stopped in the wrong place. Nobody will notice either.
stakes.coop: No forward, no back. Work together or work alone.

choices.label: Say "Sorry for your loss" and ask to pass through the canopy edge
Climb the fence to the left and drop into the next compound
Tell the bouncer you are with the catering and they sent you the wrong street
Wait for a car to arrive and slip through with the mourners

recap.default: {winner} says sorry and the bouncer steps aside, one foot. It is enough. {loser} says sorry too quiet and the bouncer does not move.
recap.coop: You say sorry and the bouncer steps aside, one foot. It is enough.

recap.default: {winner} climbs and drops into a compound with a barking dog. The dog is chained. {loser} climbs and drops into a compound with a loose dog.
recap.coop: You climb and drop into a compound with a barking dog. The dog is chained.

recap.default: {winner} says catering and the bouncer says, "Which catering?" But he is thinking. {loser} says catering and the bouncer says, "You be thief."
recap.coop: You say catering and the bouncer says, "Which catering?" But he is thinking.

recap.default: {winner} waits. A car arrives, doors open, and they walk through with the family. {loser} waits too long and the bouncer says, "You still dey here?"
recap.coop: You wait. A car arrives, doors open, and you walk through with the family.

recap.default: {winner} says sorry and the bouncer says, "You know who die?" They do not.
recap.coop: You say sorry and the bouncer says, "You know who die?" You do not.

recap.default: {winner} climbs the fence and the top wire cuts their hand. They fall back into the canopy.
recap.coop: You climb the fence and the top wire cuts your hand. You fall back into the canopy.

recap.default: {winner} says catering. The bouncer calls to somebody inside. Somebody comes.
recap.coop: You say catering. The bouncer calls to somebody inside. Somebody comes.

recap.default: {winner} waits. No car comes. The bouncer watches them wait.
recap.coop: You wait. No car comes. The bouncer watches you wait.

tie.recap: You both stand there. The bouncer says, "Make una choose side."

bridge_toll.title: The Bridge
bridge_toll.text: You are at the bridge. The boys are close enough to touch. The one in the centre does the talking. The others watch his face, not yours. He says, "Night don fall. Wetin you bring?" It is not a robbery. It is a tax.

stakes.default: How you pay decides whether the phone and the cash make it to the rent transfer.
stakes.coop: How you pay decides what you keep. Decide together.

choices.label: Smile and say "I sabi you. You be Tunde, abi? How your mama?"
Hand over ₦500 and keep walking without stopping

lock.reason: You don't have money left to pay with.

choices.label: Say "My uncle na DPO. You wan make I call am?"
Ask "How much make I pass?" and negotiate like it is normal

recap.default: {winner} names him right. He squints, then laughs. "You get memory. Waka." {loser} names him wrong and he says, "My name no be Tunde."
recap.coop: You name him right. He squints, then laughs. "You get memory. Waka."

recap.default: {winner} drops ₦500 and walks. Somebody counts it and says, "This one sabi road." {loser} drops ₦500 and stops to say thank you. They do not like thank you.
recap.coop: You drop ₦500 and walk. Somebody counts it and says, "This one sabi road."

recap.default: {winner} says DPO and the centre boy spits. "Every night, DPO. Waka before I change my mind." {loser} says DPO and he says, "Call am now."
recap.coop: You say DPO and the centre boy spits. "Every night, DPO. Waka before I change my mind."

recap.default: {winner} asks the price. "₦300." They pay and walk. No drama. {loser} asks the price and haggles. The price goes up to ₦1,000.
recap.coop: You ask the price. "₦300." You pay and walk. No drama.

recap.default: {winner} guesses a name. It is his enemy's name. He does not laugh.
recap.coop: You guess a name. It is his enemy's name. He does not laugh.

recap.default: {winner} has no ₦500. They offer the phone. He takes it.
recap.coop: You have no ₦500. You offer the phone. He takes it.

recap.default: {winner} says DPO. He says, "I dey wait." They do not call.
recap.coop: You say DPO. He says, "I dey wait." You do not call.

recap.default: {winner} asks the price. He says, "Everything for your pocket."
recap.coop: You ask the price. He says, "Everything for your pocket."

tie.recap: You both stand there. He says, "Una dey waste my night."

bridge_heated.title: Trouble
bridge_heated.text: Something went wrong. The centre boy is not talking now. He is walking toward you. The others are off the railings. The music is still playing but nobody is listening. This is the moment before it becomes something else.

stakes.default: They are not asking for a toll anymore. Your phone and your cash are both on the table.
stakes.coop: Fix it now or run. Stay together or lose together.

choices.label: Say "Na play o. We be friends. Make I buy una something?"
Run. Now.
Shout "I sabi Ajala! Anybody touch me go hear am!"
Drop your phone and money on the ground and back away

recap.default: {winner} offers to buy something. The centre boy says, "You go buy am tomorrow. Waka." {loser} offers too late and he says, "Tomorrow no dey for you."
recap.coop: You offer to buy something. The centre boy says, "You go buy am tomorrow. Waka."

recap.default: {winner} runs and they do not chase. Not tonight. {loser} runs and one of them throws a bottle. It does not hit.
recap.coop: You run and they do not chase. Not tonight.

recap.default: {winner} shouts Ajala's name and the centre boy stops. He knows Ajala. Everybody knows Ajala. {loser} shouts the same name and he says, "Ajala no dey here."
recap.coop: You shout Ajala's name and the centre boy stops. He knows Ajala. Everybody knows Ajala.

recap.default: {winner} drops phone and money. The centre boy picks them up and says, "You sabi road. Waka." {loser} drops only the money and he says, "Where the phone?"
recap.coop: You drop phone and money. The centre boy picks them up and says, "You sabi road. Waka."

recap.default: {winner} smiles and the centre boy slaps them. Not hard. Enough.
recap.coop: You smile and the centre boy slaps you. Not hard. Enough.

recap.default: {winner} runs and they catch them at the corner. Three against one.
recap.coop: You run and they catch you at the corner. Three against one.

recap.default: {winner} shouts Ajala. The centre boy says, "Ajala don travel."
recap.coop: You shout Ajala. The centre boy says, "Ajala don travel."

recap.default: {winner} drops the money but keeps the phone in their other hand. He sees.
recap.coop: You drop the money but keep the phone in your other hand. He sees.

tie.recap: You both freeze. The centre boy says, "So una no wan waka?" They do not ask again.

vigilante_post.title: Safe House
vigilante_post.text: The vigilante post is a wooden shed with a bench and a torch. Two men in vests sit outside. One is asleep. The other looks at you and says, "Night don fall. You dey go house?" The road past here is lit. Your house is five minutes away.

stakes.default: They can see you home, or keep you here all night while Mum's dot sits still.
stakes.coop: Almost home. The last stretch is together.

choices.label: Say "Yes o. These boys for bridge no gree me pass."
Walk past without stopping, almost home
Say "I be DPO pikin. Make una escort me reach house."
Ask which houses got robbed last month and avoid those streets

recap.default: {winner} tells the bridge story. The awake one stands up. "Make I walk with you." {loser} says nothing and the asleep one wakes up confused.
recap.coop: You tell the bridge story. The awake one stands up. "Make I walk with you."

recap.default: {winner} walks past. The awake one says, "Safe journey." {loser} walks past too fast and he says, "Why you dey run?"
recap.coop: You walk past. The awake one says, "Safe journey."

recap.default: {winner} says DPO pikin. The awake one looks at the asleep one. "You hear am?" Neither moves. {loser} says it louder and the asleep one says, "Wetin?"
recap.coop: You say DPO pikin. The awake one looks at the asleep one. "You hear am?" Neither moves.

recap.default: {winner} asks about robberies. The awake one points left. "That street last week. Go right." {loser} asks and he says, "Everywhere. Night na night."
recap.coop: You ask about robberies. The awake one points left. "That street last week. Go right."

recap.default: {winner} complains about the boys. The awake one says, "Dem dey there every night. You no know?"
recap.coop: You complain about the boys. The awake one says, "Dem dey there every night. You no know?"

recap.default: {winner} runs past. The asleep one wakes up and shouts, "Thief!"
recap.coop: You run past. The asleep one wakes up and shouts, "Thief!"

recap.default: {winner} says DPO. The awake one says, "Your father no send you money for Uber?"
recap.coop: You say DPO. The awake one says, "Your father no send you money for Uber?"

recap.default: {winner} asks about robberies. The awake one says, "Why you dey ask? You wan plan one?"
recap.coop: You ask about robberies. The awake one says, "Why you dey ask? You wan plan one?"

tie.recap: You both stand there. The asleep one snores. The awake one says, "Una dey go or una dey stay?"

back_lane.title: The Long Way
back_lane.text: The lane behind the mechanic yard is dark and smells of oil. You can hear the bridge from here but you cannot see it. A dog barks once and stops. Your shoes are loud on the gravel. Somebody's window is open. A baby is crying.

stakes.default: Quiet, which is either very good or very bad. Mum's dot is the only light that knows where you are.
stakes.coop: The long way is the quiet way. Stay together.

choices.label: Whistle a familiar tune so anyone listening knows you are not hiding
Run the last stretch where the lane meets the main road
Shout "Who get dog wey dey bark? Make una tie am!"
Walk on the grass edge where the gravel does not crunch

recap.default: {winner} whistles "Buga." The baby stops crying. Somebody laughs from the window. {loser} whistles out of tune and the dog barks again.
recap.coop: You whistle "Buga." The baby stops crying. Somebody laughs from the window.

recap.default: {winner} runs and bursts onto the main road past the bridge. The boys do not see. {loser} runs and slips on oil. The noise carries.
recap.coop: You run and burst onto the main road past the bridge. The boys do not see.

recap.default: {winner} shouts about the dog. A man shouts back, "Na your dog?" But the window closes. {loser} shouts and the dog barks until the whole street is awake.
recap.coop: You shout about the dog. A man shouts back, "Na your dog?" But the window closes.

recap.default: {winner} walks on the grass. No crunch. No bark. No problem. {loser} steps back on gravel to avoid a puddle and the crunch is loud.
recap.coop: You walk on the grass. No crunch. No bark. No problem.

recap.default: {winner} whistles and the window slams shut. The baby cries louder.
recap.coop: You whistle and the window slams shut. The baby cries louder.

recap.default: {winner} runs into the main road and the boys are right there. They were waiting.
recap.coop: You run into the main road and the boys are right there. They were waiting.

recap.default: {winner} shouts and the man comes outside with a stick.
recap.coop: You shout and the man comes outside with a stick.

recap.default: {winner} walks on the grass and steps in something soft. It smells.
recap.coop: You walk on the grass and step in something soft. It smells.

tie.recap: You both freeze. The dog barks again. The baby stops. Somebody says, "Who dey there?"

home_stretch.title: Almost Home
home_stretch.text: Your street is two minutes away. The gate is visible. You can see the light in your window, or maybe it is the neighbour's. The dot on Mum's phone is almost still. She is watching. The rent is waiting.

stakes.default: Two minutes from the gate. Mum's dot is nearly home, so do not trip now.

choices.label: Wave at the neighbour's window like you are already safe
Sprint the last two minutes and don't stop until the gate
Call Mum loud enough for anyone listening: "Mummy I dey gate o!"
Walk normal, check your pocket, make sure everything is there

recap.default: {winner} waves and the neighbour waves back. Anybody watching sees a person who belongs here. {loser} waves at the wrong window and nobody waves back.
recap.coop: You wave and the neighbour waves back. Anybody watching sees a person who belongs here.

recap.default: {winner} sprints and the gate opens before they knock. Mum has been watching. {loser} sprints and slips at the gate. Mum hears the fall.
recap.coop: You sprint and the gate opens before you knock. Mum has been watching.

recap.default: {winner} shouts for Mum and she shouts back, "I dey come!" The street knows somebody is waiting. {loser} shouts and she does not hear. The street knows somebody is alone.
recap.coop: You shout for Mum and she shouts back, "I dey come!" The street knows somebody is waiting.

recap.default: {winner} checks their pocket. Phone, money, keys. Everything that matters. {loser} checks and the phone is at 2%. The dot dies before the gate.
recap.coop: You check your pocket. Phone, money, keys. Everything that matters.

recap.default: {winner} waves and the neighbour shouts, "Thief!" Wrong window.
recap.coop: You wave and the neighbour shouts, "Thief!" Wrong window.

recap.default: {winner} sprints and runs into a group coming out of a compound. They are not happy.
recap.coop: You sprint and run into a group coming out of a compound. They are not happy.

recap.default: {winner} shouts for Mum. Somebody else answers, "Your mummy no dey house."
recap.coop: You shout for Mum. Somebody else answers, "Your mummy no dey house."

recap.default: {winner} checks their pocket. Empty. The money fell somewhere back there.
recap.coop: You check your pocket. Empty. The money fell somewhere back there.

tie.recap: You both walk the last two minutes. The gate is there. Mum is there. The night is over.

mugged.title: Taken
mugged.text: They take the phone. They take the money. They take the shoes if they want them. You are on the ground or you are standing, but you are empty either way. The bridge is behind you. Your house is still ahead.

stakes.default: Empty pockets and a dark dot. Get yourself home before Mum starts calling the whole street.
stakes.coop: Empty pockets, dead phone. The night is not over.

choices.label: Say "Boys, na mistake. Make I just waka. I no go talk."
Run. Even without shoes. Even without hope.
Shout "I sabi Ajala! This night no go end well for una!"
Sit down and wait. They will leave when they are bored.

recap.default: {winner} says mistake and the centre boy says, "Every night, mistake. Waka." {loser} begs too long and he says, "You don waste my time."
recap.coop: You say mistake and the centre boy says, "Every night, mistake. Waka."

recap.default: {winner} runs barefoot and the gravel cuts but they do not stop. The gate is close. {loser} runs and falls. The gravel cuts deeper.
recap.coop: You run barefoot and the gravel cuts but you do not stop. The gate is close.

recap.default: {winner} shouts Ajala and the centre boy spits. "Ajala don travel. But waka before I change my mind." {loser} shouts Ajala and he says, "I go tell am say you dey cry."
recap.coop: You shout Ajala and the centre boy spits. "Ajala don travel. But waka before I change my mind."

recap.default: {winner} sits down. The centre boy says, "You dey rest for my bridge?" But he is bored. He waves them off. {loser} sits and he says, "You go pay rent for here?"
recap.coop: You sit down. The centre boy says, "You dey rest for my bridge?" But he is bored. He waves you off.

recap.default: {winner} begs and the centre boy says, "You don beg enough. Waka."
recap.coop: You beg and the centre boy says, "You don beg enough. Waka."

recap.default: {winner} runs and they chase for ten metres then stop. Not worth it.
recap.coop: You run and they chase for ten metres then stop. Not worth it.

recap.default: {winner} shouts Ajala and he says, "Ajala no dey. But your mouth too much." He slaps them. Not hard. Enough.
recap.coop: You shout Ajala and he says, "Ajala no dey. But your mouth too much." He slaps you. Not hard. Enough.

recap.default: {winner} sits too long. He says, "You wan sleep here?" They do not sleep there.
recap.coop: You sit too long. He says, "You wan sleep here?" You do not sleep there.

tie.recap: You both stand there, empty. The centre boy says, "Una no get anything again?" He waves you off. Not worth the paperwork.

home_safe.title: Home
home_safe.text: The gate closes behind you. Mum's tracker dot has stopped at the house, and your phone buzzes before you can catch your breath. The rent transfer is on its way. Tonight you made it, and now you get to decide how to tell it.

stakes.default: Get inside first and tell the story your way. Mum's transfer is one gate away.
stakes.coop: Get inside together and decide how to tell it.

choices.label: Call out to the gateman cheerfully so he opens up fast
Jog the last stretch and get to the gate first
Make the story bigger in your head and tell it loudly as you enter
Walk in calm, lock everything, then plan the story

twists.text: {holder}: Your pocket is lighter than it should be. Mallam can tell from how you walk.
{holder}: Your hand keeps patting the empty pocket, as if the phone will come back.

endings.win: You are through your gate first, with your phone, your money and your mouth all intact. Mum's tracker dot stops at home, the rent transfer lands, and you tell the story your way. {loser} is still on the road.
endings.loss: You reach a perfectly clean gate, phone and money intact, and Mum's rent transfer lands. But {winner} is already inside telling it with big hands. You buy the suya.

success.default: You both reach your gates with phones, money and mouths intact. Mum's tracker dot stops at home and the rent transfer lands. Nobody walks alone again.
success.solo: You reach the gate with your phone, your money and your mouth intact. Mum's dot stops at home and the rent transfer lands. Next time, you will take a Bolt.

endings.fail: You get home with everything intact, but so late that Mum has called six times. The transfer comes with a very long voice note.

home_battered.title: Home, Barely
home_battered.text: You reach your gate shaken and a little lighter, but on your own feet. Mallam slides the bolt without a word. Mum's dot stops at the house, and she is already calling.

stakes.default: Get inside first, and decide how much of the story is true before Mum's transfer lands.
stakes.coop: Get inside and decide how much of the story is true.

choices.label: Greet Mallam calmly so he does not ask too much
Go straight to your door and lock it behind you
Tell it bigger than it was so the whole compound stays up with you
Check yourself, lock up, and keep the story short until morning

twists.text: {holder}: Your pocket is lighter than it should be. Mallam can tell from how you walk.

endings.win: You push your gate open first, shaken and a little lighter in the pocket, but whole. Mum's dot stops at home and the transfer lands. {loser} is still out there.
endings.loss: You get in shaken but whole, and Mum's transfer lands. But {winner} was home first and is telling it with big hands. You buy the suya.

success.default: You both get to your gates tired and shaken, but fine. Mum's dot stops at home and the transfer lands. Nobody walks alone again.
success.solo: You get to the gate tired and shaken, but fine. Mum's dot stops at home and the transfer lands. Next time, you will take a Bolt.

endings.fail: You get home late and shaken, with half your calm. Mum's dot stopped at home an hour after she wanted it to, and the transfer comes with questions.

home_robbed.title: Home, Empty
home_robbed.text: You reach your gate with your shirt pulled out of place, no phone, no money and a ringing in your ears. Mallam looks at you a long time, then slides the bolt. "Ah ah. Wetin happen?" Mum's dot went dark an hour ago. You still need to get inside and reach her.

stakes.default: Your dot went dark and the money is gone. Get inside and get Mum on the line before the transfer slips.
stakes.coop: You lost things tonight. Don't lose the story too.

choices.label: Borrow Mallam's phone and call home in a calm voice
Go straight to the neighbour's door and bang until somebody wakes up
Tell it bigger than it was so the whole compound stays up and worries with you
Check yourself, block the SIM, lock the compound, report in the morning

twists.text: {holder}: Your hand keeps patting the empty pocket, as if the phone will come back.

endings.win: You reach the gate first with empty pockets, no phone and a ringing in your ears. Mum's dot went dark an hour ago, so she is calling Mallam's line, and the rent transfer waits until morning. You won the race and lost the night. {loser} will tell it better.
endings.loss: You reach the gate with no phone and no cash, and {winner} is already inside. Mum's dot went dark an hour ago and the rent transfer waits until morning. The suya is on credit.

success.default: You both scrape home with half your things. Mum's dot went dark on the road, so the rent transfer waits until she hears your voices. It comes with a lecture.
success.solo: You scrape home with half your things. Mum's dot went dark on the road, so the rent transfer waits until she hears your voice. It comes with a lecture.

endings.fail: You get home late, with nothing in your pockets. Mum's dot went dark an hour ago, and the transfer waits until she hears every detail. The group chat has the story first.

endings.win: You push your gate open first, and Mum's tracker dot stops at home. The rent transfer lands. {loser} buys suya tomorrow and tells it badly.
endings.loss: {winner} is already inside telling the story with big hands before you clear the street. Mum's transfer waits on your dot reaching home. You buy the suya.

success.default: You both get to the gate together, tired but fine. Nobody walks alone again.
success.solo: You get to the gate tired but fine. Next time, you will take a Bolt.

fail.default: You get home late and shaken, with half your things. The group chat will have the story before you sleep.
fail.solo: You get home late and shaken, with half your things. The group chat will have the story before you sleep.

epilogues.text: Since that night, you read every street before you walk it.
The boys now greet you by name whenever you pass. It is respect, or something close.
The boys have your face in their memory now. Avoid that road for a while.
You paid small money to get home. Next time you will carry a ₦200 note separately.
You got home with an empty pocket and a very long story.
Your phone went off in the dark. You charged it fully for three days after.
The big name you used got back to its owner. Enjoy that conversation.
The vigilante men now wave at you from their plastic chairs every evening.
You will be buying a new phone this month.
The keke rider now saves your number. Last trip, any time.
